dedupe_keys.name: a uav based framework for vehicle trajectory extraction and kinematic validation in heterogeneous highway work zones

description: Amit Kumar Patel and Digvijay Pawar publish paired vehicle trajectories from a heterogeneous work zone on India’s NH-65 near Sangareddy. Zenodo provides two public ZIPs under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. A drone at about 120 m captured overhead traffic, while an instrumented vehicle supplied synchronized V-Box observations. The deposit says additional DataFromSky and processing outputs support comparison of vehicle detection, trajectory stitching and kinematic conditioning. These pairs can calibrate work-zone car-following or validate a trajectory-extraction pipeline before traffic simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this field-validation set. A limitation is that the page does not give observation dates, route length, sample rate or the number of tracked vehicles. Video clips and trajectories are linked to one site and may not transfer to different lane rules or vehicle mixes. No archive was downloaded and positional error was not recalculated.
